title: Deployment change decisions, impacts and authorized access need a verified change trace
remediation: Release maintainers and deployment change authority sample a configuration-controlled change. Record security and privacy impact review with named representatives, approval or refusal, effective access restrictions, isolated test validation, monitored change deployment and post-change verification of each affected control. Include review records and applicable authorized-access decisions. Use G7 and G12 only for their scoped repository evidence.

milestones.title: Collect one approved change with pre-change analysis, restricted access, separate test evidence and operating-control checks after deployment
